understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN, and completing all levels won the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions shifted the currently selected piece by one grid cell, equivalent to 3 pixels, using pixel coordinates. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed when moving into them, while walls and boundaries generally blocked movement, though their blocking behavior could vary and had to be tested. CLICK switched control to another selectable piece using its displayed pixel/grid position, not semantic-grid cell indices.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN, and completing all levels won the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions shifted the currently selected piece by one grid cell, equivalent to 3 pixels, using pixel coordinates. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed when moving into them, while walls and boundaries generally blocked movement, though their blocking behavior could vary and had to be tested. CLICK switched control to another selectable piece using its displayed pixel/grid position, not semantic-grid cell indices.
